text_block_list.text:
Even at Nice Nature's preferred distance, 
she fell short against Tokai Teio in the 
Satsuki Sho.

While Nice Nature broods over her 
frustration, Tokai Teio brims with 
motivation, declaring she'll train hard 
for the next race.

Looking at her, Nice Nature realized that 
she was an endlessly distant presence she 
could never reach.
